 // Moves to specific plot/range/plot_id\n    private void moveToSearch(String type, int[] rangeID, String range, String plot, String data) {\n\n        if (rangeID == null) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        boolean haveData = false;\n\n        // search moveto\n        if (type.equals("search")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.range.equals(range) & cRange.plot.equals(plot)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to plot\n        if (type.equals("plot")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.plot.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to range\n        if (type.equals("range")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.range.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to plot id\n        if (type.equals("id")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.plot_id.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    return;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!haveData) {\n            Utils.makeToast(getApplicationContext(), getString(R.string.main_toolbar_moveto_no_match));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void moveToResultCore(int j) {\n        rangeBox.setPaging(j);\n\n        // Reload traits based on selected plot\n        rangeBox.display();\n        traitBox.setNewTraits(rangeBox.getPlotID());\n\n        initWidgets(false);\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void onPause() {\n        // Backup database\n   }\n\n        Log.w(parent, value);\n        traitBox.update(parent, value);\n\n        Observation observation = dt.getObservation(rangeBox.getPlotID(), parent);\n        String observationDbId = lastSyncedTime);\n    }\n\n    private void brapiDelete(String parent, Boolean hint) {\n        Toast.makeText(getApplicationContext(), getString(R.string.brapi_delete_message), EditText etCurVal;\n    public final Handler myGuiHandler = new Handler() {\n        @Override\n        public void handleMessage(Message msg) {\n            synchronized (lock) {\n                switch (msg.what) {\n                    case 1:\n                        ImageView btn = findViewById(msg.arg1);\n                        if (btn.getTag() != null) {  // button is still pressed\n                            // schedule next btn pressed check\n                            Message msg1 = new Message();\n                            msg1.copyFrom(msg);\n                            if (msg.arg1 == R.id.rangeLeft) {\n                                rangeBox.repeatKeyPress("left");\n                            } else {\n                                rangeBox.repeatKeyPress("right");\n                            }\n                            myGuiHandler.removeMessages(1);\n                            myGuiHandler.sendMessageDelayed(msg1, msg1.arg2);\n                        }\n                        break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    };\n\n    private TextWatcher cvText;\n    private InputMethodManager imm;\n    private Boolean dataLocked = false;\n\n    public static void disableViews(ViewGroup layout) {\n        layout.setEnabled(false);\n        for (int i = 0; i < layout.getChildCount(); i++) {\n            View child = layout.getChildAt(i);\n            if (child instanceof ViewGroup) {\n                disableViews((ViewGroup) child);\n            } else {\n                child.setEnabled(false);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    public static void enableViews(ViewGroup layout) {\n        layout.setEnabled(false);\n        for (int i = 0; i < layout.getChildCount(); i++) {\n            View child = layout.getChildAt(i);\n            if (child instanceof ViewGroup) {\n                enableViews((ViewGroup) child);\n            } else {\n                child.setEnabled(true);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    public void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {\n        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);\n\n        ep = getSharedPreferences("Settings", 0);\n        if void initCurrentVals() {\n        // Current value display\n        etCurVal = findViewById(R.id.etCurVal);\n\n        etCurVal.setOnEditorActionListener(new OnEditorActionListener() {\n            public boolean onEditorAction(TextView exampleView, int actionId, KeyEvent event) {\n                if (actionId == EditorInfo.IME_NULL && event.getAction() == KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {\n                    rangeBox.rightClick();\n                    return true;\n                }\n\n                return false;\n            }\n        });\n\n        // Validates the text entered for text format\n        cvText = new TextWatcher() {\n            public void afterTextChanged(Editable en) {\n                final TraitObject trait = traitBox.getCurrentTrait();\n                if (en.toString().length() > 0) {\n                    if (traitBox.existsNewTraits() & trait != null)\n                        updateTrait(trait.getTrait(), trait.getFormat(), en.toString());\n                } else {\n                    if (traitBox.existsNewTraits() & trait != null)\n                        removeTrait(trait.getTrait());\n                }\n                //tNum.setSelection(tNum.getText().length());\n            }\n\n            public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence arg0, int arg1,\n                                          int arg2, int arg3) {\n            }\n\n            public void onTextChanged(CharSequence arg0, int arg1, int arg2,\n                                      int arg3) {\n            }\n\n        };\n    }\n\n    private void loadScreen() {\n        setContentView(R.layout.activity_collect);\n\n        initToolbars();\n\n        if (getSupportActionBar() != null) {\n            getSupportActionBar().setTitle(null);\n            getSupportActionBar().getThemedContext();\n            getSupportActionBar().setDisplayHomeAsUpEnabled(true);\n            getSupportActionBar().setHomeButtonEnabled(true);\n        }\n\n        // If the app is just starting up, we must always allow refreshing of data onscreen\n        reloadData = true;\n\n        lock = new Object();\n\n        thisActivity = this;\n\n        // Keyboard service manager\n        setIMM();\n\n        infoBarAdapter = new InfoBarAdapter(this, ep.getInt(GeneralKeys.INFOBAR_NUMBER, 2), (RecyclerView) findViewById(R.id.selectorList));\n\n        traitLayouts = new LayoutCollections(this);\n        traitBox = new TraitBox(this);\n        rangeBox = new RangeBox(this);\n        initCurrentVals();\n\n    }\n\n    private void refreshMain() {\n        rangeBox.saveLastPlot();\n        rangeBox.refresh();\n        traitBox.setNewTraits(rangeBox.getPlotID());\n\n        initWidgets(true);\n    }\n\n    private void playSound(String sound) {\n        try {\n            int resID = getResources().getIdentifier(sound, "raw", getPackageName());\n            MediaPlayer chimePlayer = MediaPlayer.create(CollectActivity.this, resID);\n            chimePlayer.start();\n\n            chimePlayer.setOnCompletionListener(new MediaPlayer.OnCompletionListener() {\n                public void onCompletion(MediaPlayer mp) {\n                    mp.release();\n                }\n            });\n        } catch (Exception ignore) {\n        }\n    }\n\n    private boolean validateData() {\n        final String strValue = etCurVal.getText().toString();\n        final TraitObject currentTrait = traitBox.getCurrentTrait();\n\n        // no trait is selected (e.g. the field has no traits), nothing to validate\n        if (currentTrait == null) {\n            return true;\n        }\n\n        final String trait = currentTrait.getTrait();\n\n        if (traitBox.existsNewTraits()\n                && etCurVal.getText().toString().length() > 0\n                && !currentTrait.isValidValue(etCurVal.getText().toString())) {\n\n            if (strValue.length() > 0 && currentTrait.isOver(strValue)) {\n                Utils.makeToast(getApplicationContext(),getString(R.string.trait_error_maximum_value)\n                        + ": " + currentTrait.getMaximum());\n            } else if (strValue.length() > 0 && currentTrait.isUnder(strValue)) {\n                Utils.makeToast(getApplicationContext(),getString(R.string.trait_error_minimum_value)\n                        + ": " + currentTrait.getMinimum());\n            }\n\n            removeTrait(trait);\n            etCurVal.getText().clear();\n\n            playSound("error");\n\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    private void setNaText() {\n        etCurVal.setText("NA");\n\n        traitLayouts.setNaTraitsText(traitBox.getCurrentFormat());\n    }\n\n    private void setNaTextBrapiEmptyField() {\n        etCurVal.setHint("NA");\n\n        traitLayouts.setNaTraitsText(traitBox.getCurrentFormat());\n    }\n\n    private void initToolbars() {\n        Toolbar toolbar = findViewById(R.id.toolbar);\n        setSupportActionBar(toolbar);\n\n        Toolbar toolbarBottom = findViewById(R.id.toolbarBottom);\n\n        missingValue = toolbarBottom.findViewById(R.id.missingValue);\n        missingValue.setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {\n            @Override\n            public void onClick(View v) {\n                TraitObject currentTrait = traitBox.getCurrentTrait();\n                updateTrait(currentTrait.getTrait(), currentTrait.getFormat(), "NA");\n                setNaText();\n            }\n        });\n\n        deleteValue = toolbarBottom.findViewById(R.id.deleteValue);\n        deleteValue.setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {\n            @Override\n            public void onClick(View v) {\n\n                // if a brapi observation that has been synced, don\'t allow deleting\n                TraitObject currentTrait = traitBox.getCurrentTrait();\n                if (dt.isBrapiSynced(rangeBox.getPlotID(), currentTrait.getTrait())) {\n                    if (currentTrait.getFormat().equals("photo")) {\n                        // I want to use abstract method\n                        Map newTraits = traitBox.getNewTraits();\n                        PhotoTraitLayout traitPhoto = traitLayouts.getPhotoTrait();\n                        traitPhoto.brapiDelete(newTraits);\n                    } else {\n                        brapiDelete(currentTrait.getTrait(), false);\n                    }\n                } else {\n                    traitLayouts.deleteTraitListener(currentTrait.getFormat());\n                }\n            }\n        });\n\n    }\n\n    // This update should only be called after repeating keypress ends\n    private void repeatUpdate() {\n        if (rangeBox.getRangeID() == null)\n            return;\n\n        traitBox.setNewTraits(rangeBox.getPlotID());\n\n        initWidgets(true);\n    }\n\n    // This is central to the application\n    // Calling this function resets all the controls for traits, and picks one\n    // to show based on the current trait data\n    private void initWidgets(final boolean rangeSuppress) {\n        // Reset dropdowns\n\n        if (!dt.isTableEmpty(DataHelper.RANGE)) {\n            final String plotID = rangeBox.getPlotID();\n            infoBarAdapter.configureDropdownArray(plotID);\n        }\n\n        traitBox.initTraitDetails();\n\n        // trait is unique, format is not\n        String[] traits = dt.getVisibleTrait();\n        if (traits != null) {\n            ArrayAdapter<String> directionArrayAdapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(\n                    this, R.layout.custom_spinnerlayout, traits);\n            directionArrayAdapter\n                    .setDropDownViewResource(R.layout.custom_spinnerlayout);\n            traitBox.initTraitType(directionArrayAdapter, rangeSuppress);\n\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Moves to specific plot/range/plot_id\n    private void moveToSearch(String type, int[] rangeID, String range, String plot, String data) {\n\n        if (rangeID == null) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        boolean haveData = false;\n\n        // search moveto\n        if (type.equals("search")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.range.equals(range) & cRange.plot.equals(plot)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to plot\n        if (type.equals("plot")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.plot.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to range\n        if (type.equals("range")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.range.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to plot id\n        if (type.equals("id")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.plot_id.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    return;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!haveData) {\n            Utils.makeToast(getApplicationContext(), getString(R.string.main_toolbar_moveto_no_match));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void moveToResultCore(int j) {\n        rangeBox.setPaging(j);\n\n        // Reload traits based on selected plot\n        rangeBox.display();\n        traitBox.setNewTraits(rangeBox.getPlotID());\n\n        initWidgets(false);\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void onPause() {\n        // Backup database\n        try {\n            dt.exportDatabase("backup");\n            File exportedDb = new File(Constants.BACKUPPATH + "/" + "backup.db");\n            File exportedSp = new File(Constants.BACKUPPATH + "/" + "backup.db_sharedpref.xml");\n            Utils.scanFile(CollectActivity.this, exportedDb);\n            Utils.scanFile(CollectActivity.this, exportedSp);\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            Log.e(TAG, e.getMessage());\n        }\n\n        super.onPause();\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void onDestroy() {\n        //save last plot id\n        if (ep.getBoolean("ImportFieldFinished", false)) {\n            rangeBox.saveLastPlot();\n        }\n\n        super.onDestroy();\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void onResume() {\n        super.onResume();\n\n        // Update menu item visibility\n        if (systemMenu != null) {\n            systemMenu.findItem(R.id.help).setVisible(ep.getBoolean("Tips", false));\n            systemMenu.findItem(R.id.jumpToPlot).setVisible(ep.getBoolean(GeneralKeys.UNIQUE_TEXT, false));\n            systemMenu.findItem(R.id.nextEmptyPlot).setVisible(ep.getBoolean(GeneralKeys.NEXT_ENTRY_NO_DATA, false));\n            systemMenu.findItem(R.id.barcodeScan).setVisible(ep.getBoolean(GeneralKeys.UNIQUE_CAMERA, false));\n            systemMenu.findItem(R.id.datagrid).setVisible(ep.getBoolean(GeneralKeys.DATAGRID_SETTING, false));\n        }\n\n        // If reload data is true, it means there was an import operation, and\n        // the screen should refresh\n        if (ConfigActivity.dt == null) {\n            ConfigActivity.dt = new DataHelper(this);\n        }\n\n        ConfigActivity.dt.open();\n\n        if (reloadData) {\n            reloadData = false;\n            partialReload = false;\n\n            // displayRange moved to RangeBox#display\n            // and display in RangeBox#reload is commented out\n            rangeBox.reload();\n            traitBox.setPrefixTraits();\n\n            initWidgets(false);\n            traitBox.setSelection(0);\n\n            // try to go to last saved plot\n            if (ep.getString("lastplot", null) != null) {\n                rangeBox.setAllRangeID();\n                int[] rangeID = rangeBox.getRangeID();\n                moveToSearch("id", rangeID, null, null, ep.getString("lastplot", null));\n            }\n\n        } else if (partialReload) {\n            partialReload = false;\n            rangeBox.display();\n            traitBox.setPrefixTraits();\n            initWidgets(false);\n\n        } else if (searchReload) {\n            searchReload = false;\n            rangeBox.resetPaging();\n            int[] rangeID = rangeBox.getRangeID();\n\n            if (rangeID != null) {\n                moveToSearch("search", rangeID, searchRange, searchPlot, null);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Helper function update user data in the memory based hashmap as well as\n     * the database\n     */\n    public void updateTrait(String parent, String trait, String value) {\n\n        if (rangeBox.isEmpty()) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        Log.w(parent, value);\n        traitBox.update(parent, value);\n\n        Observation observation = dt.getObservation(rangeBox.getPlotID(), parent);\n        String observationDbId = observation.getDbId();\n        OffsetDateTime lastSyncedTime = observation.getLastSyncedTime();\n\n        // Always remove existing trait before inserting again\n        // Based on plot_id, prevent duplicates\n        dt.deleteTrait(rangeBox.getPlotID(), parent);\n\n        String exp_id = Integer.toString(ep.getInt("SelectedFieldExpId", 0));\n        dt.insertUserTraits(rangeBox.getPlotID(), parent, trait, value,\n                ep.getString("FirstName", "") + " " + ep.getString("LastName", ""),\n                ep.getString("Location", ""), "", exp_id, observationDbId,\n                lastSyncedTime);\n    }\n\n    private void brapiDelete(String parent, Boolean hint) {\n        Toast.makeText(getApplicationContext(), getString(R.string.brapi_delete_message), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();\n        TraitObject trait = traitBox.getCurrentTrait();\n        updateTrait(parent, trait.getFormat(), getString(R.string.brapi_na));\n        if (hint) {\n            setNaTextBrapiEmptyField();\n        } else {\n            setNaText();\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Delete trait, including from database\n    public void removeTrait(String parent) {\n        if (rangeBox.isEmpty()) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        TraitObject trait = traitBox.getCurrentTrait();\n        if (dt.isBrapiSynced(rangeBox.getPlotID(), trait.getTrait())) {\n            brapiDelete(parent, true);\n        } else {\n            // Always remove existing trait before inserting again\n            // Based on plot_id, prevent duplicate\n            traitBox.remove(parent, rangeBox.getPlotID());\n        }\n    }\n\n    // for format without specific control\n    public void removeTrait() {\n        traitBox.remove(traitBox.getCurrentTrait(), rangeBox.getPlotID());\n        etCurVal.setText("");\n    }\n\n    private void customizeToolbarIcons() {\n        Set<String> entries = ep.getStringSet(GeneralKeys.TOOLBAR_CUSTOMIZE, new systemMenu.findItem(R.id.lockData).setVisible(entries.contains("lockData"));\n        }\n    }\n\n\n\n    @Override\n    public boolean onCreateOptionsMenu(Menu menu) {\n        new private TapTarget collectDataTapTargetView(int id, String title, String desc, int color, int targetRadius) {\n        return TapTarget.forView(findViewById(id), title, desc)\n                // All options below are optional\n                .outerCircleColor(color)      // Specify a color for the outer circle\n                .outerCircleAlpha(0.95f)            // Specify the alpha amount for the outer circle\n                .targetCircleColor(R.color.black)   // Specify a color for the target circle\n                .titleTextSize(30)                  // Specify the size (in sp) of the title text\n                .descriptionTextSize(20)            // Specify the size (in sp) of the description text\n                .descriptionTextColor(R.color.black)  // Specify the color of the description text\n                .descriptionTypeface(Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD)\n                .textColor(R.color.black)            // Specify a color for both the title and description text\n                .dimColor(R.color.black)            // If set, will dim behind the view with 30% opacity of the given color\n                .drawShadow(true)                   // Whether to draw a drop shadow or not\n                .cancelable(false)                  // Whether tapping outside the outer circle dismisses the view\n                .tintTarget(true)                   // Whether to tint the target view\'s color\n                .transparentTarget(true)           // Specify whether the target is transparent (displays the content underneath)\n                .targetRadius(targetRadius);\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public boolean onOptionsItemSelected(MenuItem item) {\n\n        Intent intent = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW);\n\n        switch (item.getItemId()) {\n            case                 collectDataTapTargetView(R.id.rangeLeft, getString(R.string.tutorial_main_entries_title), getString(R.string.tutorial_main_entries_description), R.color.main_primaryDark,60),\n                                collectDataTapTargetView(R.id.valuesPlotRangeHolder, getString(R.string.tutorial_main_navinfo_title), getString(R.string.tutorial_main_navinfo_description), (systemMenu.findItem(R.id.search).isVisible()) {\n                    sequence.target(collectDataTapTargetView(R.id.search, getString(R.string.tutorial_main_search_title), sequence.target(collectDataTapTargetView(R.id.resources, getString(R.string.tutorial_main_resources_title), getString(R.string.tutorial_main_resources_description), R.color.main_primaryDark,60));\n                }\n                if (systemMenu.findItem(R.id.summary).isVisible()) {\n                    sequence.target(collectDataTapTargetView(R.id.summary, getString(R.string.tutorial_main_summary_title), getString(R.string.tutorial_main_summary_description), R.color.main_primaryDark,60));\n                }\n                if (systemMenu.findItem(R.id.lockData).isVisible()) {\n                    sequence.target(collectDataTapTargetView(R.id.lockData, getString(R.string.tutorial_main_lockdata_title), getString(R.string.tutorial_main_lockdata_description), R.color.main_primaryDark,60));\n                }\n\n                sequence.start();\n                break;\n            case R.id.search:\n                intent.setClassName(CollectActivity.this,\n                        SearchActivity.class.getName());\n                startActivity(intent);\n                break;\n\n            case R.id.resources:\n                intent.setClassName(CollectActivity.this,\n                        FileExploreActivity.class.getName());\n                intent.putExtra("path", Constants.RESOURCEPATH);\n                intent.putExtra("exclude", new String[]{"fieldbook"});\n                intent.putExtra("title", getString(R.string.main_toolbar_resources));\n                startActivityForResult(intent, 1);\n                break;\n            case R.id.nextEmptyPlot:\n                nextEmptyPlot();\n                break;\n            case R.id.jumpToPlot:\n                moveToPlotID();\n                break;\n            case R.id.barcodeScan:\n                new IntentIntegrator(this)\n                        .setPrompt(getString(R.string.main_barcode_text))\n                        .setBeepEnabled(true)\n                        .initiateScan();\n                break;\n            case R.id.summary:\n                showSummary();\n                break;\n            case R.id.datagrid:\n                intent.setClassName(CollectActivity.this,\n observation.getDbId();\n        OffsetDateTime lastSyncedTime = observation.getLastSyncedTime();\n\n        // Always remove existing trait before inserting again\n        // Based on plot_id, prevent duplicates\n        dt.deleteTrait(rangeBox.getPlotID(), parent);\n\n        String exp_id = Integer.toString(ep.getInt("SelectedFieldExpId", 0));\n        dt.insertUserTraits(rangeBox.getPlotID(), parent, trait, value,\n                ep.getString("FirstName", "") + " " + ep.getString("LastName", ""),\n                ep.getString("Location", ""), "", exp_id, observationDbId,\n                lastSyncedTime);\n    }\n\n    private void brapiDelete(String parent, Boolean hint) {\n        Toast.makeText(getApplicationContext(), getString(R.string.brapi_delete_message), (strValue.length() > 0 && currentTrait.isUnder(strValue)) {\n                Utils.makeToast(getApplicationContext(),getString(R.string.trait_error_minimum_value)\n                        + ": " + currentTrait.getMinimum());\n            }\n\n            removeTrait(trait);\n            etCurVal.getText().clear();\n\n            playSound("error");\n\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    private void setNaText() {\n        etCurVal.setText("NA");\n\n        final String format = traitBox.getCurrentFormat();\n        if (format != null) {\n            traitLayouts.setNaTraitsText(format);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void setNaTextBrapiEmptyField() {\n        etCurVal.setHint("NA");\n\n        final String format = This is central to the application\n    // Calling this function resets all the controls for traits, and picks one\n    // to show based on the current trait data\n    private void initWidgets(final boolean rangeSuppress) {\n        // Reset dropdowns\n\n        if (!dt.isTableEmpty(DataHelper.RANGE)) {\n            final String plotID = rangeBox.getPlotID();\n  // Moves to specific plot/range/plot_id\n    private void moveToSearch(String type, int[] rangeID, String range, String plot, String data) {\n\n        if (rangeID == null) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        boolean haveData = false;\n\n        // search moveto\n        if (type.equals("search")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.range.equals(range) & cRange.plot.equals(plot)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to plot\n        if (type.equals("plot")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.plot.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to range\n        if (type.equals("range")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.range.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to plot id\n        if (type.equals("id")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.plot_id.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    return;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!haveData) {\n            Utils.makeToast(getApplicationContext(), getString(R.string.main_toolbar_moveto_no_match));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void moveToResultCore(int j) {\n        rangeBox.setPaging(j);\n\n        // Reload traits based on selected plot\n        rangeBox.display();\n        traitBox.setNewTraits(rangeBox.getPlotID());\n\n        initWidgets(false);\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void onPause() {\n        // Backup database\n "backup.db_sharedpref.xml");\n            Utils.scanFile(CollectActivity.this, exportedDb);\n            Utils.scanFile(CollectActivity.this, exportedSp);\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            Log.e(TAG, e.getMessage());\n        }\n\n        super.onPause();\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void onDestroy() {\n        //save last plot id\n        if (ep.getBoolean("ImportFieldFinished", visibility\n        if (systemMenu != null) {\n            systemMenu.findItem(R.id.help).setVisible(ep.getBoolean("Tips", false));\n            systemMenu.findItem(R.id.jumpToPlot).setVisible(ep.getBoolean(GeneralKeys.UNIQUE_TEXT, false));\n systemMenu.findItem(R.id.datagrid).setVisible(ep.getBoolean(GeneralKeys.DATAGRID_SETTING, false));\n        }\n\n        // If reload data is true, it means there was an import operation, and\n        // the screen should refresh\n        if (ConfigActivity.dt == null) {\n            ConfigActivity.dt = new DataHelper(this);\n        }\n\n        ConfigActivity.dt.open();\n\n        if (reloadData) {\n            reloadData = false;\n            partialReload = false;\n\n            // displayRange moved to RangeBox#display\n            // and display in RangeBox#reload is commented out\n            rangeBox.reload();\n            traitBox.setPrefixTraits();\n\n            initWidgets(false);\n            traitBox.setSelection(0);\n\n            // try to go to last saved plot\n            if (ep.getString("lastplot", null) != null) {\n                rangeBox.setAllRangeID();\n                int[] rangeID = rangeBox.getRangeID();\n                moveToSearch("id", rangeID, null, null, ep.getString("lastplot", null));\n            }\n\n        } else if (partialReload) {\n            partialReload = false;\n            rangeBox.display();\n            traitBox.setPrefixTraits();\n            initWidgets(false);\n\n        } else if (searchReload) {\n            searchReload = false;\n            rangeBox.resetPaging();\n            int[] rangeID = rangeBox.getRangeID();\n\n            if (rangeID != null) {\n                moveToSearch("search", rangeID, searchRange, searchPlot, null);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Helper function update user data in the memory based hashmap as well as\n     * the database\n     */\n    public void updateTrait(String parent, String trait, String value) {\n\n        if (rangeBox.isEmpty()) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        Log.w(parent, value);\n        traitBox.update(parent, value);\n\n        Observation observation = dt.getObservation(rangeBox.getPlotID(), parent);\n        String observationDbId = observation.getDbId();\n        OffsetDateTime lastSyncedTime = observation.getLastSyncedTime();\n\n        // Always remove existing trait before inserting again\n        // Based on plot_id, prevent duplicates\n        dt.deleteTrait(rangeBox.getPlotID(), parent);\n\n        String exp_id = Integer.toString(ep.getInt("SelectedFieldExpId", 0));\n        dt.insertUserTraits(rangeBox.getPlotID(), parent, trait, value,\n                ep.getString("FirstName", "") + " " + ep.getString("LastName", ""),\n                ep.getString("Location", ""), "", exp_id, observationDbId,\n                lastSyncedTime);\n    }\n\n    private void brapiDelete(String parent, Boolean hint) {\n        Toast.makeText(getApplicationContext(), getString(R.string.brapi_delete_message), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();\n        TraitObject trait = traitBox.getCurrentTrait();\n        updateTrait(parent, trait.getFormat(), getString(R.string.brapi_na));\n        if (hint) {\n            setNaTextBrapiEmptyField();\n        } else {\n            setNaText();\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Delete trait, including from database\n    public void removeTrait(String parent) {\n        if (rangeBox.isEmpty()) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        TraitObject trait = traitBox.getCurrentTrait();\n        if (dt.isBrapiSynced(rangeBox.getPlotID(), trait.getTrait())) {\n            brapiDelete(parent, true);\n        } else {\n            // Always remove existing trait before inserting again\n            // Based on plot_id, prevent duplicate\n            traitBox.remove(parent, rangeBox.getPlotID());\n        }\n    }\n\n    // for format without specific control\n    public void removeTrait() {\n        traitBox.remove(traitBox.getCurrentTrait(), (action == KeyEvent.ACTION_UP) {\n                        rangeBox.moveEntryRight();\n                    }\n                    return true;\n                }\n                return false;\n            case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_VOLUME_DOWN:\n                if (ep.getBoolean(GeneralKeys.VOLUME_NAVIGATION, false)) {\n                    if (action == KeyEvent.ACTION_UP) {\n                        rangeBox.moveEntryLeft();\n                    }\n                    return true;\n                }\n                return false;\n            case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER:\n                String return_action = ep.getString(GeneralKeys.RETURN_CHARACTER, "0");\n\n                if (return_action.equals("0")) {\n                    if (action == KeyEvent.ACTION_UP) {\n                        rangeBox.moveEntryRight();\n                        return false;\n                    }\n                }\n\n                if (return_action.equals("1")) {\n                    if (action == KeyEvent.ACTION_UP) {\n                        traitBox.moveTrait("right");\n                        return true;\n                    }\n                }\n\n                if (return_action.equals("2")) {\n                    return true;\n                }\n\n                return false;\n            default:\n                return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event);\n        }\n    }\n\n    protected void onActivityResult(int requestCode, int resultCode, Intent data) {\n        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data);\n\n        switch (requestCode) {\n                     repeatHandler = null;\n\n                            repeatUpdate();\n                            break;\n                        case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:\n specific plot/range/plot_id\n    private void moveToSearch(String type, int[] rangeID, String range, String plot, String data) {\n\n        if (rangeID == null) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        boolean haveData = false;\n\n        // search moveto\n        if (type.equals("search")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.range.equals(range) & cRange.plot.equals(plot)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to plot\n        if (type.equals("plot")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.plot.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to range\n        if (type.equals("range")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.range.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to plot id\n        if (type.equals("id")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.plot_id.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    return;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!haveData) {\n            Utils.makeToast(getApplicationContext(), getString(R.string.main_toolbar_moveto_no_match));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void moveToResultCore(int j) {\n        rangeBox.setPaging(j);\n\n        // Reload traits based on selected plot\n   }\n\n        Log.w(parent, value);\n        traitBox.update(parent, value);\n\n        Observation observation = dt.getObservation(rangeBox.getPlotID(), parent);\n        String observationDbId = EditText etCurVal;\n    public final Handler myGuiHandler = new Handler() {\n        @Override\n        public void handleMessage(Message msg) {\n            synchronized (lock) {\n                switch (msg.what) {\n                    case 1:\n                        ImageView btn = findViewById(msg.arg1);\n                        if (btn.getTag() != null) {  // button is still pressed\n                            // schedule next btn pressed check\n                            Message msg1 = new Message();\n                            msg1.copyFrom(msg);\n                            if (msg.arg1 == R.id.rangeLeft) {\n                                rangeBox.repeatKeyPress("left");\n                            } else {\n                                rangeBox.repeatKeyPress("right");\n                            }\n                            myGuiHandler.removeMessages(1);\n                            myGuiHandler.sendMessageDelayed(msg1, msg1.arg2);\n                        }\n                        break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    };\n\n    private TextWatcher cvText;\n    private InputMethodManager imm;\n    private Boolean dataLocked = false;\n\n    public static void disableViews(ViewGroup layout) {\n        layout.setEnabled(false);\n        for (int i = 0; i < layout.getChildCount(); i++) {\n            View child = layout.getChildAt(i);\n            if (child instanceof ViewGroup) {\n                disableViews((ViewGroup) child);\n            } else {\n                child.setEnabled(false);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    public static void enableViews(ViewGroup layout) {\n        layout.setEnabled(false);\n        for (int i = 0; i < layout.getChildCount(); i++) {\n            View child = layout.getChildAt(i);\n            if (child instanceof ViewGroup) {\n                enableViews((ViewGroup) child);\n            } else {\n                child.setEnabled(true);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    public void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {\n        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);\n\n        ep = getSharedPreferences("Settings", 0);\n        if void initCurrentVals() {\n        // Current value display\n        etCurVal = findViewById(R.id.etCurVal);\n\n        etCurVal.setOnEditorActionListener(new OnEditorActionListener() {\n            public boolean onEditorAction(TextView exampleView, int actionId, KeyEvent event) {\n                if (actionId == EditorInfo.IME_NULL && event.getAction() == KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {\n                    rangeBox.rightClick();\n                    return true;\n                }\n\n                return false;\n            }\n        });\n\n        // Validates the text entered for text format\n        cvText = new TextWatcher() {\n            public void afterTextChanged(Editable en) {\n                final TraitObject trait = traitBox.getCurrentTrait();\n                if (en.toString().length() > 0) {\n                    if (traitBox.existsNewTraits() & trait != null)\n                        updateTrait(trait.getTrait(), trait.getFormat(), en.toString());\n                } else {\n                    if (traitBox.existsNewTraits() & trait != null)\n                        removeTrait(trait.getTrait());\n                }\n                //tNum.setSelection(tNum.getText().length());\n            }\n\n            public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence arg0, int arg1,\n                                          int arg2, int arg3) {\n            }\n\n            public void onTextChanged(CharSequence arg0, int arg1, int arg2,\n                                      int arg3) {\n            }\n\n        };\n    }\n\n    private void loadScreen() {\n        setContentView(R.layout.activity_collect);\n\n        initToolbars();\n\n        if (getSupportActionBar() != null) {\n            getSupportActionBar().setTitle(null);\n            getSupportActionBar().getThemedContext();\n            getSupportActionBar().setDisplayHomeAsUpEnabled(true);\n            getSupportActionBar().setHomeButtonEnabled(true);\n        }\n\n        // If the app is just starting up, we must always allow refreshing of data onscreen\n        reloadData = true;\n\n        lock = new Object();\n\n        thisActivity = this;\n\n        // Keyboard service manager\n        setIMM();\n\n        infoBarAdapter = new InfoBarAdapter(this, ep.getInt(GeneralKeys.INFOBAR_NUMBER, 2), (RecyclerView) findViewById(R.id.selectorList));\n\n        traitLayouts = new LayoutCollections(this);\n        traitBox = new TraitBox(this);\n        rangeBox = new RangeBox(this);\n        initCurrentVals();\n\n    }\n\n    private void refreshMain() {\n        rangeBox.saveLastPlot();\n        rangeBox.refresh();\n        traitBox.setNewTraits(rangeBox.getPlotID());\n\n        initWidgets(true);\n    }\n\n    private void playSound(String sound) {\n        try {\n            int resID = getResources().getIdentifier(sound, "raw", getPackageName());\n            MediaPlayer chimePlayer = MediaPlayer.create(CollectActivity.this, resID);\n            chimePlayer.start();\n\n            chimePlayer.setOnCompletionListener(new MediaPlayer.OnCompletionListener() {\n                public void onCompletion(MediaPlayer mp) {\n                    mp.release();\n                }\n            });\n        } catch (Exception ignore) {\n        }\n    }\n\n    private boolean validateData() {\n        final String strValue = etCurVal.getText().toString();\n        final TraitObject currentTrait = traitBox.getCurrentTrait();\n\n        // no trait is selected (e.g. the field has no traits), nothing to validate\n        if (currentTrait == null) {\n            return true;\n        }\n\n        final String trait = currentTrait.getTrait();\n\n        if (traitBox.existsNewTraits()\n                && etCurVal.getText().toString().length() > 0\n                && !currentTrait.isValidValue(etCurVal.getText().toString())) {\n\n            if (strValue.length() > 0 && currentTrait.isOver(strValue)) {\n                Utils.makeToast(getApplicationContext(),getString(R.string.trait_error_maximum_value)\n                        + ": " + currentTrait.getMaximum());\n            } else if (strValue.length() > 0 && currentTrait.isUnder(strValue)) {\n                Utils.makeToast(getApplicationContext(),getString(R.string.trait_error_minimum_value)\n                        + ": " + currentTrait.getMinimum());\n            }\n\n            removeTrait(trait);\n            etCurVal.getText().clear();\n\n            playSound("error");\n\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    private void setNaText() {\n        etCurVal.setText("NA");\n\n        final String format = traitBox.getCurrentFormat();\n        if (format != null) {\n            traitLayouts.setNaTraitsText(format);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void setNaTextBrapiEmptyField() {\n        etCurVal.setHint("NA");\n\n        final String format = traitBox.getCurrentFormat();\n        if (format != null) {\n            traitLayouts.setNaTraitsText(format);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void initToolbars() {\n        Toolbar toolbar = findViewById(R.id.toolbar);\n        setSupportActionBar(toolbar);\n\n        Toolbar toolbarBottom = findViewById(R.id.toolbarBottom);\n\n        missingValue = toolbarBottom.findViewById(R.id.missingValue);\n        missingValue.setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {\n            @Override\n            public void onClick(View v) {\n                TraitObject currentTrait = traitBox.getCurrentTrait();\n                if (currentTrait == null) {  // no trait selected, nothing to score\n                    return;\n                }\n                updateTrait(currentTrait.getTrait(), currentTrait.getFormat(), "NA");\n                setNaText();\n            }\n        });\n\n        deleteValue = toolbarBottom.findViewById(R.id.deleteValue);\n        deleteValue.setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {\n            @Override\n            public void onClick(View v) {\n\n                // if a brapi observation that has been synced, don\'t allow deleting\n                TraitObject currentTrait = traitBox.getCurrentTrait();\n                if (currentTrait == null) {  // no trait selected, nothing to delete\n                    return;\n                }\n                if (dt.isBrapiSynced(rangeBox.getPlotID(), currentTrait.getTrait())) {\n                    if (currentTrait.getFormat().equals("photo")) {\n                        // I want to use abstract method\n                        Map newTraits = traitBox.getNewTraits();\n                        PhotoTraitLayout traitPhoto = traitLayouts.getPhotoTrait();\n                        traitPhoto.brapiDelete(newTraits);\n                    } else {\n                        brapiDelete(currentTrait.getTrait(), false);\n                    }\n                } else {\n                    traitLayouts.deleteTraitListener(currentTrait.getFormat());\n                }\n            }\n        });\n\n    }\n\n    // This update should only be called after repeating keypress ends\n    private void repeatUpdate() {\n        if (rangeBox.getRangeID() == null)\n            return;\n\n        traitBox.setNewTraits(rangeBox.getPlotID());\n\n        initWidgets(true);\n    }\n\n    // This is central to the application\n    // Calling this function resets all the controls for traits, and picks one\n    // to show based on the current trait data\n    private void initWidgets(final boolean rangeSuppress) {\n        // Reset dropdowns\n\n        if (!dt.isTableEmpty(DataHelper.RANGE)) {\n            final String plotID = rangeBox.getPlotID();\n            infoBarAdapter.configureDropdownArray(plotID);\n        }\n\n        traitBox.initTraitDetails();\n\n        // trait is unique, format is not\n        String[] traits = dt.getVisibleTrait();\n        if (traits != null && traits.length > 0) {\n            ArrayAdapter<String> directionArrayAdapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(\n                    this, R.layout.custom_spinnerlayout, traits);\n            directionArrayAdapter\n                    .setDropDownViewResource(R.layout.custom_spinnerlayout);\n            traitBox.initTraitType(directionArrayAdapter, rangeSuppress);\n\n        } else {\n            // No traits available, there is nothing to collect.\n            // Clear the current trait and hide every trait layout, otherwise\n            // a layout could be interacted with while no trait is selected.\n            traitBox.clearCurrentTrait();\n            traitLayouts.hideLayouts();\n            etCurVal.setVisibility(EditText.GONE);\n            etCurVal.setEnabled(false);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Moves to specific plot/range/plot_id\n    private void moveToSearch(String type, int[] rangeID, String range, String plot, String data) {\n\n        if (rangeID == null) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        boolean haveData = false;\n\n        // search moveto\n        if (type.equals("search")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.range.equals(range) & cRange.plot.equals(plot)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to plot\n        if (type.equals("plot")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.plot.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to range\n        if (type.equals("range")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.range.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to plot id\n        if (type.equals("id")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.plot_id.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    return;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!haveData) {\n            Utils.makeToast(getApplicationContext(), getString(R.string.main_toolbar_moveto_no_match));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void moveToResultCore(int j) {\n        rangeBox.setPaging(j);\n\n        // Reload traits based on selected plot\n        rangeBox.display();\n        traitBox.setNewTraits(rangeBox.getPlotID());\n\n        initWidgets(false);\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void onPause() {\n        // Backup database\n        try {\n            dt.exportDatabase("backup");\n            File exportedDb = new File(Constants.BACKUPPATH + "/" + "backup.db");\n            File exportedSp = new File(Constants.BACKUPPATH + "/" + "backup.db_sharedpref.xml");\n            Utils.scanFile(CollectActivity.this, exportedDb);\n            Utils.scanFile(CollectActivity.this, exportedSp);\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            Log.e(TAG, e.getMessage());\n        }\n\n        super.onPause();\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void onDestroy() {\n        //save last plot id\n        if (ep.getBoolean("ImportFieldFinished", false)) {\n            rangeBox.saveLastPlot();\n        }\n\n        super.onDestroy();\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void onResume() {\n        super.onResume();\n\n        // Update menu item visibility\n        if (systemMenu != null) {\n            systemMenu.findItem(R.id.help).setVisible(ep.getBoolean("Tips", false));\n            systemMenu.findItem(R.id.jumpToPlot).setVisible(ep.getBoolean(GeneralKeys.UNIQUE_TEXT, false));\n            systemMenu.findItem(R.id.nextEmptyPlot).setVisible(ep.getBoolean(GeneralKeys.NEXT_ENTRY_NO_DATA, false));\n            systemMenu.findItem(R.id.barcodeScan).setVisible(ep.getBoolean(GeneralKeys.UNIQUE_CAMERA, false));\n            systemMenu.findItem(R.id.datagrid).setVisible(ep.getBoolean(GeneralKeys.DATAGRID_SETTING, false));\n        }\n\n        // If reload data is true, it means there was an import operation, and\n        // the screen should refresh\n        if (ConfigActivity.dt == null) {\n            ConfigActivity.dt = new DataHelper(this);\n        }\n\n        ConfigActivity.dt.open();\n\n        if (reloadData) {\n            reloadData = false;\n            partialReload = false;\n\n            // displayRange moved to RangeBox#display\n            // and display in RangeBox#reload is commented out\n            rangeBox.reload();\n            traitBox.setPrefixTraits();\n\n            initWidgets(false);\n            traitBox.setSelection(0);\n\n            // try to go to last saved plot\n            if (ep.getString("lastplot", null) != null) {\n                rangeBox.setAllRangeID();\n                int[] rangeID = rangeBox.getRangeID();\n                moveToSearch("id", rangeID, null, null, ep.getString("lastplot", null));\n            }\n\n        } else if (partialReload) {\n            partialReload = false;\n            rangeBox.display();\n            traitBox.setPrefixTraits();\n            initWidgets(false);\n\n        } else if (searchReload) {\n            searchReload = false;\n            rangeBox.resetPaging();\n            int[] rangeID = rangeBox.getRangeID();\n\n            if (rangeID != null) {\n                moveToSearch("search", rangeID, searchRange, searchPlot, null);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Helper function update user data in the memory based hashmap as well as\n     * the database\n     */\n    public void updateTrait(String parent, String trait, String value) {\n\n        if (rangeBox.isEmpty()) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        Log.w(parent, value);\n        traitBox.update(parent, value);\n\n        Observation observation = dt.getObservation(rangeBox.getPlotID(), parent);\n        String observationDbId = observation.getDbId();\n        OffsetDateTime lastSyncedTime = observation.getLastSyncedTime();\n\n        // Always remove existing trait before inserting again\n        // Based on plot_id, prevent duplicates\n        dt.deleteTrait(rangeBox.getPlotID(), parent);\n\n        String exp_id = Integer.toString(ep.getInt("SelectedFieldExpId", 0));\n        dt.insertUserTraits(rangeBox.getPlotID(), parent, trait, value,\n                ep.getString("FirstName", "") + " " + ep.getString("LastName", ""),\n                ep.getString("Location", ""), "", exp_id, observationDbId,\n                lastSyncedTime);\n    }\n\n    private void brapiDelete(String parent, Boolean hint) {\n        Toast.makeText(getApplicationContext(), getString(R.string.brapi_delete_message), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();\n        TraitObject trait = traitBox.getCurrentTrait();\n        updateTrait(parent, trait.getFormat(), getString(R.string.brapi_na));\n        if (hint) {\n            setNaTextBrapiEmptyField();\n        } else {\n            setNaText();\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Delete trait, including from database\n    public void removeTrait(String parent) {\n        if (rangeBox.isEmpty()) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        TraitObject trait = traitBox.getCurrentTrait();\n        if (dt.isBrapiSynced(rangeBox.getPlotID(), trait.getTrait())) {\n            brapiDelete(parent, true);\n        } else {\n            // Always remove existing trait before inserting again\n            // Based on plot_id, prevent duplicate\n            traitBox.remove(parent, rangeBox.getPlotID());\n        }\n    }\n\n    // for format without specific control\n    public void removeTrait() {\n        traitBox.remove(traitBox.getCurrentTrait(), rangeBox.getPlotID());\n        etCurVal.setText("");\n    }\n\n    private void customizeToolbarIcons() {\n        Set<String> entries = ep.getStringSet(GeneralKeys.TOOLBAR_CUSTOMIZE, new systemMenu.findItem(R.id.resources).setVisible(entries.contains("resources"));\n            systemMenu.findItem(R.id.summary).setVisible(entries.contains("summary"));\n            systemMenu.findItem(R.id.lockData).setVisible(entries.contains("lockData"));\n        }\n    }\n\n\n\n    @Override\n    public boolean onCreateOptionsMenu(Menu menu) {\n        new private TapTarget collectDataTapTargetView(int id, String title, String desc, int color, int targetRadius) {\n        return TapTarget.forView(findViewById(id), title, desc)\n                // All options below are optional\n                .outerCircleColor(color)      // Specify a color for the outer circle\n                .outerCircleAlpha(0.95f)            // Specify the alpha amount for the outer circle\n                .targetCircleColor(R.color.black)   // Specify a color for the target circle\n                .titleTextSize(30)                  // Specify the size (in sp) of the title text\n                .descriptionTextSize(20)            // Specify the size (in sp) of the description text\n                .descriptionTextColor(R.color.black)  // Specify the color of the description text\n                .descriptionTypeface(Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD)\n                .textColor(R.color.black)            // Specify a color for both the title and description text\n                .dimColor(R.color.black)            // If set, will dim behind the view with 30% opacity of the given color\n                .drawShadow(true)                   // Whether to draw a drop shadow or not\n                .cancelable(false)                  // Whether tapping outside the outer circle dismisses the view\n                .tintTarget(true)                   // Whether to tint the target view\'s color\n                .transparentTarget(true)           // Specify whether the target is transparent (displays the content underneath)\n                .targetRadius(targetRadius);\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public boolean onOptionsItemSelected(MenuItem item) {\n\n        Intent intent = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW);\n\n        switch (item.getItemId()) {\n            case                 collectDataTapTargetView(R.id.rangeLeft, getString(R.string.tutorial_main_entries_title), getString(R.string.tutorial_main_entries_description), R.color.main_primaryDark,60),\n                                collectDataTapTargetView(R.id.valuesPlotRangeHolder, getString(R.string.tutorial_main_navinfo_title), getString(R.string.tutorial_main_navinfo_description), sequence.target(collectDataTapTargetView(R.id.resources, getString(R.string.tutorial_main_resources_title), getString(R.string.tutorial_main_resources_description), R.color.main_primaryDark,60));\n                }\n                if (systemMenu.findItem(R.id.summary).isVisible()) {\n                    sequence.target(collectDataTapTargetView(R.id.summary, getString(R.string.tutorial_main_summary_title), getString(R.string.tutorial_main_summary_description), R.color.main_primaryDark,60));\n                }\n                if (systemMenu.findItem(R.id.lockData).isVisible()) {\n                    sequence.target(collectDataTapTargetView(R.id.lockData, getString(R.string.tutorial_main_lockdata_title), getString(R.string.tutorial_main_lockdata_description), R.color.main_primaryDark,60));\n                }\n\n                sequence.start();\n                break;\n            case R.id.search:\n                intent.setClassName(CollectActivity.this,\n                        SearchActivity.class.getName());\n                startActivity(intent);\n                break;\n\n            case R.id.resources:\n                intent.setClassName(CollectActivity.this,\n                        FileExploreActivity.class.getName());\n                intent.putExtra("path", Constants.RESOURCEPATH);\n                intent.putExtra("exclude", new String[]{"fieldbook"});\n                intent.putExtra("title", getString(R.string.main_toolbar_resources));\n                startActivityForResult(intent, 1);\n                break;\n            case R.id.nextEmptyPlot:\n                nextEmptyPlot();\n                break;\n            case R.id.jumpToPlot:\n                moveToPlotID();\n                break;\n            case R.id.barcodeScan:\n                new IntentIntegrator(this)\n                        .setPrompt(getString(R.string.main_barcode_text))\n                        .setBeepEnabled(true)\n                        .initiateScan();\n                break;\n            case R.id.summary:\n                showSummary();\n                break;\n            case R.id.datagrid:\n                intent.setClassName(CollectActivity.this,\n                        DatagridActivity.class.getName());\n                startActivityForResult(intent, 2);\n                break;\n            case R.id.lockData:\n                dataLocked = !dataLocked;\n                lockData(dataLocked);\n                break;\n            case android.R.id.home:\n                finish();\n                break;\n        }\n        return super.onOptionsItemSelected(item);\n    }\n\n    void lockData(boolean lock) {\n        if (lock) {\n            systemMenu.findItem(R.id.lockData).setIcon(R.drawable.ic_tb_lock);\n            missingValue.setEnabled(false);\n (currentTrait == null) {\n            return true;\n        }\n\n        final String trait = currentTrait.getTrait();\n\n        if (traitBox.existsNewTraits()\n                && etCurVal.getText().toString().length() > 0\n                && !currentTrait.isValidValue(etCurVal.getText().toString())) {\n\n            if (strValue.length() > 0 && currentTrait.isOver(strValue)) {\n                Utils.makeToast(getApplicationContext(),getString(R.string.trait_error_maximum_value)\n                        + ": " + currentTrait.getMaximum());\n            } else if (strValue.length() > 0 && currentTrait.isUnder(strValue)) {\n                Utils.makeToast(getApplicationContext(),getString(R.string.trait_error_minimum_value)\n                        + ": " + currentTrait.getMinimum());\n            }\n\n            removeTrait(trait);\n            etCurVal.getText().clear();\n\n            playSound("error");\n\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    private void setNaText() {\n        etCurVal.setText("NA");\n\n        final String format = traitBox.getCurrentFormat();\n        if (format != null) {\n            traitLayouts.setNaTraitsText(format);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void setNaTextBrapiEmptyField() {\n        etCurVal.setHint("NA");\n\n        final String format =     updateTrait(currentTrait.getTrait(), currentTrait.getFormat(), "NA");\n                setNaText();\n            }\n        });\n\n        deleteValue = // if a brapi observation that has been synced, don\'t allow deleting\n                TraitObject currentTrait = traitBox.getCurrentTrait();\n                if (currentTrait == null) {  // no trait selected, nothing to delete\n                    return;\n                }\n                if (dt.isBrapiSynced(rangeBox.getPlotID(), currentTrait.getTrait())) {\n                    if       }\n        });\n\n    }\n\n    // This update should only be called after repeating keypress ends\n    private void repeatUpdate() {\n        if (rangeBox.getRangeID() == null)\n            return;\n\n        traitBox.setNewTraits(rangeBox.getPlotID());\n\n        initWidgets(true);\n    }\n\n    // This is central to the application\n    // Calling this function resets all the controls for traits, and picks one\n    // to show based on the current trait data\n    private void initWidgets(final boolean rangeSuppress) {\n        // Reset dropdowns\n\n        if .setDropDownViewResource(R.layout.custom_spinnerlayout);\n            traitBox.initTraitType(directionArrayAdapter, rangeSuppress);\n\n        } else {\n            // No traits available, there is traitBox.clearCurrentTrait();\n            traitLayouts.hideLayouts();\n            etCurVal.setVisibility(EditText.GONE);\n            etCurVal.setEnabled(false);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Moves to specific plot/range/plot_id\n    private void moveToSearch(String type, int[] rangeID, String range, String plot, String data) {\n\n        if (rangeID == null) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        boolean haveData = false;\n\n        // search moveto\n        if (type.equals("search")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.range.equals(range) & cRange.plot.equals(plot)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to plot\n        if (type.equals("plot")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.plot.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to range\n        if (type.equals("range")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.range.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to plot id\n        if (type.equals("id")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.plot_id.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    return;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!haveData) {\n            Utils.makeToast(getApplicationContext(), getString(R.string.main_toolbar_moveto_no_match));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void moveToResultCore(int j) {\n        rangeBox.setPaging(j);\n\n        // Reload traits based on selected plot\n        rangeBox.display();\n        traitBox.setNewTraits(rangeBox.getPlotID());\n\n        initWidgets(false);\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void onPause() {\n        // Backup database\n "backup.db_sharedpref.xml");\n            Utils.scanFile(CollectActivity.this, exportedDb);\n            Utils.scanFile(CollectActivity.this, exportedSp);\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n          initWidgets(false);\n\n        } else if (searchReload) {\n            searchReload = false;\n            rangeBox.resetPaging();\n            int[] rangeID = rangeBox.getRangeID();\n\n            if (rangeID != null) {\n                moveToSearch("search", rangeID, searchRange, searchPlot, null);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Helper function update user data in the memory based hashmap as well as\n     * the database\n     */\n    public void updateTrait(String parent, String trait, String value) {\n\n        if (rangeBox.isEmpty()) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        Log.w(parent, value);\n        traitBox.update(parent, value);\n\n        Observation observation = dt.getObservation(rangeBox.getPlotID(), parent);\n        String observationDbId = observation.getDbId();\n        OffsetDateTime lastSyncedTime = observation.getLastSyncedTime();\n\n        // Always remove existing trait before inserting again\n        // Based on plot_id, prevent duplicates\n        dt.deleteTrait(rangeBox.getPlotID(), parent);\n\n        String exp_id = Integer.toString(ep.getInt("SelectedFieldExpId", 0));\n        dt.insertUserTraits(rangeBox.getPlotID(), parent, trait, value,\n                ep.getString("FirstName", "") + " " + ep.getString("LastName", ""),\n                ep.getString("Location", ""), "", exp_id, observationDbId,\n                lastSyncedTime);\n    }\n\n    private void brapiDelete(String parent, Boolean hint) {\n        TraitObject trait = traitBox.getCurrentTrait();\n        if (trait == null) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        Toast.makeText(getApplicationContext(), getString(R.string.brapi_delete_message), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();\n        updateTrait(parent, trait.getFormat(), getString(R.string.brapi_na));\n        if (hint) {\n            setNaTextBrapiEmptyField();\n        } else {\n            setNaText();\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Delete trait, including from database\n    public void removeTrait(String parent) {\n        if (rangeBox.isEmpty()) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        TraitObject trait = traitBox.getCurrentTrait();\n        if (trait == null) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        if (dt.isBrapiSynced(rangeBox.getPlotID(), trait.getTrait())) {\n            brapiDelete(parent, true);\n        } else {\n            // Always remove existing trait before inserting again\n            // Based on plot_id, prevent duplicate\n            traitBox.remove(parent, rangeBox.getPlotID());\n        }\n    }\n\n    // for format (action == KeyEvent.ACTION_UP) {\n                        rangeBox.moveEntryRight();\n                    }\n                    return true;\n                }\n                return false;\n            case KeyEvent.KEYCODE_VOLUME_DOWN:\n                if (ep.getBoolean(GeneralKeys.VOLUME_NAVIGATION, false)) {\n                    if (action == KeyEvent.ACTION_UP) {\n .setDropDownViewResource(R.layout.custom_spinnerlayout);\n            traitBox.initTraitType(directionArrayAdapter, rangeSuppress);\n\n        } else {\n            // No traits available, there is specific plot/range/plot_id\n    private void moveToSearch(String type, int[] rangeID, String range, String plot, String data) {\n\n        if (rangeID == null) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        boolean haveData = false;\n\n        // search moveto\n        if (type.equals("search")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.range.equals(range) & cRange.plot.equals(plot)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to plot\n        if (type.equals("plot")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.plot.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to range\n        if (type.equals("range")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.range.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    haveData = true;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        //move to plot id\n        if (type.equals("id")) {\n            for (int j = 1; j <= rangeID.length; j++) {\n                rangeBox.setRangeByIndex(j - 1);\n                RangeObject cRange = rangeBox.getCRange();\n\n                if (cRange.plot_id.equals(data)) {\n                    moveToResultCore(j);\n                    return;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!haveData) {\n            Utils.makeToast(getApplicationContext(), getString(R.string.main_toolbar_moveto_no_match));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void moveToResultCore(int j) {\n        rangeBox.setPaging(j);\n\n        // Reload traits based on selected plot\n memory based hashmap as well as\n     * the database\n     */\n    public void updateTrait(String parent, String trait, String value) {\n\n        if (rangeBox.isEmpty()) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        Log.w(parent, value);\n        traitBox.update(parent, value);\n\n        Observation observation = dt.getObservation(rangeBox.getPlotID(), parent);\n        String observationDbId = observation.getDbId();\n        OffsetDateTime lastSyncedTime = observation.getLastSyncedTime();\n\n        // Always remove existing trait before inserting again\n        // Based on plot_id, prevent duplicates\n        dt.deleteTrait(rangeBox.getPlotID(), parent);\n\n        String exp_id = Integer.toString(ep.getInt("SelectedFieldExpId", 0));\n        dt.insertUserTraits(rangeBox.getPlotID(), lastSyncedTime);\n    }\n\n    private void brapiDelete(String parent, Boolean hint) {\n        TraitObject trait = traitBox.getCurrentTrait();\n        if (trait == null) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        Toast.makeText(getApplicationContext(), getString(R.string.brapi_delete_message), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();\n        updateTrait(parent, trait.getFormat(), getString(R.string.brapi_na));\n        if (hint) {\n            setNaTextBrapiEmptyField();\n        } else {\n            setNaText();\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Delete trait, including from database\n    public void removeTrait(String parent) {\n        if (rangeBox.isEmpty()) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        TraitObject trait = traitBox.getCurrentTrait();\n        if (trait == null) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        if (dt.isBrapiSynced(rangeBox.getPlotID(), trait.getTrait())) {\n            brapiDelete(parent, true);\n        } else {\n            // Always remove existing trait before inserting again\n            // Based on plot_id, prevent duplicate\n            traitBox.remove(parent, rangeBox.getPlotID());\n        }\n    }\n\n    // for format
